name: B2Brouter
summary: B2Brouter says it is certified as a Peppol Access Point Service Provider. Its free Basic plan is limited to 24 transactions a year. The Business plan costs 300 euros a year plus taxes and adds the legal invoice archive.

evidence.capability: e-invoice formats such as Peppol BIS and UBL

facts.text: B2Brouter says it is certified as a Peppol Access Point Service Provider and is a member of EESPA.
The page says documents are converted to the format the recipient requires, such as Peppol BIS or UBL.
The Basic plan is listed as Peppol ready. The Professional and Business plans list Peppol network features.
Only the Business plan lists legal invoice archiving. Paid plans are billed annually.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free forever. Limited to 10 contacts, 24 transactions a year and one user

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Plus taxes. Unlimited contacts and transactions, up to two users

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Plus taxes. Unlimited contacts and transactions, up to 10 users, and legal invoice archiving

hiddenCosts: Prices are listed in euros plus taxes. The page offers a Malaysian ringgit option but shows no ringgit prices.
